entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 1318 of 2025

Applicant :- Raja
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhir Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 B.N.S.S. has been filed with a prayer to direct the learned
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut to expedite the proceedings of Case No.21092 of 2022 (arising out
of Case Crime No.693 of 2021), under Sections 498A, 304-B, 323, 315 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry
Prohibition Act, Police Station Sardhana, District Meerut, within a stipulated period.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. It appears from the perusal of the record that out of three accused persons, the case of accused Dharam Singh has been committed to the court of Sessions by C.J.M, Meerut, but the other two accused persons Monu and Smt. Sangeeta are absconding and not appearing before the court, which is causing delay in the disposal of this case.

4. It also appears from the perusal of the record that earlier some relief was granted to opposite party nos.2 and 3 by this Court in Application U/S 482 No.25252 of 2023, but they did not appear before the court, as per the direction given by this Court vide order dated 22.05.2024.

entities.text: Raja vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to take all possible measures to procure the presence of the accused / opposite party nos. 2 and 3 by sending appropriate process to them and to ensure the actual compliance by the office of its own orders within three months from today and then thereafter the matter should be committed without any delay to the court of Sessions, if there is no legal impediment.

6. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.

7. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 9.5.2025 Radhika  Raja vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108876127/
